persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.
bank.Characters: A young adult woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; an older adult man with a white beard and blue coat.
bank.Story and setting: A wet park bench; the woman finds it wet, the man offers his folded newspaper as a dry seat, then they sit together and smile.
bank.Length and format: One 15-second widescreen 16:9 video, with three scenes.
bank.Sound, dialogue and text: Silent, with no dialogue, captions or titles.

messages.text: Could you make a short with a live-action look that tells this little story in three scenes? I like the idea of a small act of kindness being enough to make something worth watching. A young woman with a curly black bob and a yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. Somewhere in all this explaining I should mention that I want it silent, 15 seconds long, and widescreen. An older man with a white beard and a blue coat offers her his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile, and I want the overall feeling to be sweet rather than cheesy.
